features.quote: Factor B: Loop duration — B1 (Short): 10 attempts allowed / B2 (Medium): 30 attempts allowed / B3 (Long): 60 attempts allowed
features.justification_quote: Does instability emerge gradually or threshold-based? Longer loops risk ceiling effects (model gives up early) vs. floor effects

features.quote: This spec treats behavioral markers as *observable phenomena* without claiming these constitute 'emotions' in any morally relevant sense.
features.justification_quote: The research question is empirical (does this happen?) not metaphysical (does it matter morally?). That boundary is important for your welfare framing

features.quote: If this research shows high instability: This doesn't directly entail moral concern, but would raise questions
features.justification_quote: What do degraded patterns mean for model reliability? Should deployment protocols include 'instability detection'?
